macro.text: Futures give back part of Monday's surge (S&P 500 +4.7%, Nasdaq +6.5%, best day since April 2025): Nasdaq-100 −1.8%, S&P −1.0%, Dow −0.6% at 7:36. Nvidia −5.5% after +31.5%; Goldman says Huang's return is not a clearing event.

Fed: NY Fed's Williams said Monday inflation is too high and he would not exclude hikes at consecutive meetings, but sees no need for dramatic action. A Dec 9 25 bp hike is ~95–96% priced (CME FedWatch). The 2-year rose ~7 bp to ~4.69%; 10-year 4.89% this morning.
Oil steady after Monday's slide: WTI 80.20, Brent 86.97 (OPEC+ meets Nov 29). Dollar index 103.87 (−0.4%), gold 3,629 (−0.6%), silver −2.3% and copper −3.2% on hike worries.
China extends its pause on controls of critical mineral exports to the U.S., removing one supply-chain risk for chips and defense.
Sanofi agrees to buy Insmed for $175 a share in cash (~$41B, 17.5% over Monday's close), the biggest biotech deal in nearly three years; INSM +14.6% premarket.
Anthropic (ANT) about −6.5% premarket near 82, below its $83 IPO price, the report's AI software downside trigger (I'm built by Anthropic). Oracle sold $10B of debt at up to 8.65%; ORCL −3.8%.

bigPicture: Monday's rally came almost all overnight; the session itself went nowhere, and this morning the squeeze in chips is being sold back.
Good AI news is not enough: HPE beat and raised and is down 12% on margins. The market now pays for AI profits, not AI orders (Goldman: the AI trade hinges on returns).
Money is hiding in staples, real estate and health care, and buying consumer names that beat: the low- and middle-income shopper is holding up.
Rates still cap everything: Williams kept back-to-back hikes on the table, a Dec 9 hike is ~96% priced, and Wednesday's PCE is the last big input.
snapshot.takeaway: Monday's chip squeeze is being tested by HPE's margin warning. Treat the open as two-sided: the AI names have news that cuts both ways, while the retail beats have clean news. Wait for 10:00–10:15 and VWAP, and keep Dell tonight and PCE tomorrow in mind before holding anything.
